control.title: Customer authentication for payments and sensitive changes
control.description: Require multi-factor authentication (with at least one dynamic factor) for payments, new beneficiaries, limit changes and changes to contact details, use risk-based or adaptive checks, lock accounts after repeated failures and protect sessions against hijacking.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Authentication design document, screenshots of MFA flows, lockout and session settings, test results.
acceptance_criteria: Payments and sensitive changes need multi-factor authentication with a dynamic factor
Accounts lock after repeated failed attempts and sessions time out
Evidence comes from the live configuration or a recent test, not only a policy

requirements.title: MFA for debits, real-time fraud monitoring, 24x7 desk, 5-year logs
requirements.guidance: MFA for electronic debits unless relaxed, real-time fraud monitoring, a manned 24x7x365 desk for fraud complaints and law enforcement, audit logs kept at least five years, anti-phishing and rogue-app takedown.

requirements.title: Mobile app controls and 12-hour cooling period
requirements.guidance: Device binding and re-binding after long non-use, inactivity timeout, lockout after failed logins, block while remote-access apps run, and a 12-hour cooling period after a mobile number or email change.
